title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.conditional: Documented, with plan, policy or endpoint conditions.
definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.
definitions.unknown: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_verified: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_applicable: Does not apply to this credential.
definitions.limited: Documented for a narrower case only.

providers.name: Workday
providers.scope_notes: Covers Workday (HCM/Financials tenant APIs: SOAP WWS, REST, RaaS). Covers core Workday tenants; many authentication-policy, OAuth and REST API reference pages on doc.workday.com and Community require customer login and were not readable, so several items are unknown.

controls.name: Integration System Security Group domain permissions
controls.what: ISU access is limited to domains granted to its security group.
controls.setting: Create Security Group (Integration System Security Group) + Maintain Permissions for Security Group

controls.name: Do Not Allow UI Sessions
controls.what: Prevents the ISU from signing in to the Workday UI.

controls.name: Authentication policies with IP restrictions
controls.what: Authentication policy rules can target the ISU security group and restrict by IP and allowed authentication types.
controls.setting: Manage Authentication Policies; Activate All Pending Authentication Policy Changes

controls.name: Maintain Password Rules (System Users exempt from password expiration)
controls.what: Adding an ISU here stops its password from expiring; leaving it off keeps tenant expiry.

controls_unknown: Whether authentication-policy IP rules are enforced on each API request or only at sign-in/token issuance (authentication policy pages require login).
Whether disabling an API client or regenerating a refresh token invalidates already-issued access tokens (docs say tokens can be replayed within their lifetime).
Exact task names to disable/delete an API client and to revoke a refresh token.
Default access-token lifetime for integration clients.
Whether ISU password authentication bypasses SAML SSO / IdP conditional access.
Whether User Activity Logging records web service (SOAP/REST) calls made by ISUs; the activityLogging REST API reference requires login.
Audit event names for API client creation, refresh token generation, or client disablement.

auth_paths.name: Integration System User (ISU) user name and password

authentication.summary: An admin creates a non-person ISU with the Create Integration System User task and sets its password. Integrations send the ISU user name and password to Workday web services.

federation.details: Public docs do not say whether ISU password logins bypass SAML/SSO. Do Not Allow UI Sessions blocks UI sign-in only. ISUs can be given their own authentication policy rule (example allows User Name Password).

ip_restriction.boundary: Authentication policies support IP restrictions and can target the ISU's security group. Public docs do not say whether this is checked per web service request or only at authentication.

lifetime.summary: Password follows tenant password rules; ISU can be exempted from expiration; session timeout 0 = no expiry

renewal.summary: Same password is reused until an admin changes it.

administration.summary: Created with Create Integration System User; access comes from Integration System Security Group domain permissions.

sso.details: Authentication policies can include a rule for the ISU security group, but the ISU signs in with user name and password rather than through SSO.

offboard.details: An ISU is a dedicated non-person system account.

sso.ui: Manage Authentication Policies > Authentication Ruleset: rule for the ISU's security group > Allowed Authentication Types; then Activate All Pending Authentication Policy Changes

network.ui: Manage Authentication Policies > Authentication Ruleset: rule for the ISU's security group > Authentication Condition > Create IP Range; then Activate All Pending Authentication Policy Changes

expiry.ui: Maintain Password Rules > System Users Exempt from password expiration (remove the ISU to make its password expire)

usage.ui: View User Activity report (filter System Account = ISU); ISU related actions > Security Profile > View Signon History

log_sources.name: Update Audit report
log_sources.notes: Sign-on/sign-off times and invalid password use per account. Requires System Monitoring / Update Audit domains.

log_sources.name: View User Activity report / User Activity data source / /activityLogging REST API
log_sources.notes: Must be enabled in tenant setup; 30-day retention; export weekly. Coverage of web service calls not stated.

log_sources.name: API Activity Reports
log_sources.notes: Monthly aggregates incl. Top 10 IP Addresses; up to 13 months; US and EU only.

anomaly_cues: ISU sign-ons from IPs outside the integration's known egress
Invalid password attempts on ISU accounts
Spike in ISU activity or new tasks/reports accessed

containment.steps: Change the ISU password and/or restrict it with an authentication policy; exact disable task not public.
containment.notes: Session Timeout 0 means ISU sessions do not time out.

unknown: Exact audit event names for ISU password changes
Whether SOAP reads by ISUs appear in User Activity

calls.reveals: Public and private worker data within ISU security
calls.log_notes: Workday says it doesn't log GET requests or unsuccessful requests for web services; whether SOAP reads appear in User Activity is not stated.

unknown: No documented whoami call for ISUs
